question: Do direct binding or biochemical measurements establish a previously unreported useful oncofetal chondroitin-sulfate epitope phenotype in authentic EMC, beyond its already known glycosaminoglycan-rich matrix?
prior_gate: Verify actual primary VAR2CSA/rVAR2 or other claimed oncofetal-CS binding studies, original sarcoma pathology/model supplements and glycomic repositories. Evaluate all eligible EMC/historical labels and relevant conditions. Reuse prior matrix chemistry evaluations; do not rerun the failed44-enzyme RNA panel or treat CS gene expression as an epitope measurement.
pilot: Before any new relevant measurements, freeze the exact worthwhile unanswered comparison and antigen/assay definition. Distinguish broad CS stains from the specific proposed binding epitope, retain competition/digestion/isotype/normal-tissue controls and assay conditions, diagnose overlaps/technical repeats. No automatic EMC assignment from generic chondrosarcoma. Quantitative original values or valid primary images may support a bounded biological pilot only when sampling/controls permit; no invented pixel precision or pooled selected illustrations as patient replication.
value: A new directly measured ECM-binding phenotype could change which delivery/localization experiment is tested in EMC. Binding alone cannot establish accessible therapeutic delivery, causal function,efficacy or therapeutic window. If already established/no new useful contrast, shelf rather than write a review paper.
